headline: Anthropic buys $3.4 billion of gas turbine generators
summary: Anthropic has committed $3.4 billion to secure 1.7GW of gas-fired generators from OnePWR Solutions, taking over existing Caterpillar orders to skip a long equipment waitlist and power its own AI data centers.
